name: mapshaper
role: CLI that dissolves, simplifies, reprojects and styles GeoJSON and exports flat SVG maps
summary: mapshaper is an npm CLI that edits boundary data: dissolve, simplify by percentage, reproject, clip, join and style, then write GeoJSON, TopoJSON or a flat SVG. Its strength is shrinking heavy boundary files into a small map still or scene input with one pnpm dependency and no browser.
use_when: Heavy boundary files must become small simplified GeoJSON or a flat SVG map still
Regions need dissolving by a property and reprojecting before they enter a scene
A scripted geodata step is wanted with no GDAL or browser; d3 then draws or animates the result
avoid_when: Projecting and drawing geometry inside a seeked scene: d3
Tiled raster map stills from a style: chiitiler or maplibre-native
Heavy format conversion across exotic GIS formats: GDAL
notes: 2026-11-27: GitHub reports NOASSERTION for the licence; README and npm both say MPL-2.0.
2026-11-27: -proj and -o format=svg work in 0.8.13 though the README omits them. An unstyled SVG has no fill and renders black; use -style.

assessment.rationale: npm mapshaper 0.8.13 (lead saw 0.8.10 published 2026-11-24); repository pushed 2026-11-24; MPL-2.0 per README and npm. Only catalogue route that dissolves, simplifies, reprojects and writes SVG from the command line; d3 projects in a scene, GDAL is only a lead.

evidence.result: 3-polygon GeoJSON dissolved to 2 regions, 29 to 15 vertices at simplify 50%, projected to Web Mercator, styled SVG 800x821 with 2 paths and 2 fills; resvg 800px PNG inspected. Node 22.19.0.
evidence.scope: One tiny self-authored GeoJSON, dissolve, simplify, webmercator, style, SVG export on macOS arm64; not Shapefile, TopoJSON, clip, join, mapshaper-xl or real-size data.
